v0.2.3.description:
**Beta test.** 📖 **[Setup guide](https://github.com/Unowa001/ArchipelagoME1/blob/main/worlds/mass_effect_le1/docs/setup_en.md)**

**Downloads:** `mass_effect_le1.apworld` (double-click to install), `ArchipelagoME1-mod-0.2.3.zip` (drag into ME3Tweaks Mod Manager, don't unzip), `ArchipelagoME1-bridge-0.2.3.zip` (unzip, run `install-bridge.ps1`), and the YAML template (optional).

Updating? Replace all three parts: the apworld, the mod zip and the bridge. This version needs **bridge v11**.

### New
- **Shop item names:** while the client is connected, each Archipelago shop slot shows the item it holds (for example "Link's Hookshot"). Its description says who the item is for and whether it is progression.
- **F7 summary box:** F7 now opens one message box with the whole summary (checks in logic per region, every uncharted planet with checks in logic, what each locked world needs). Close it with its button or F7.
- **Options Creator presets:** "Story Focus" (fewer checks) and "Completionist" (everything on).
- `/notices all | important | off` in the client controls the HUD notices. Notices are wrapped so the whole text shows.

### Fixed
- **Infinite sprint** left Shepard out of breath at once. Sprinting now never tires.
- **Galaxy-map markers** did not show. Each marker now gets its own slot in its system.

### Please report
Whether shop names show (also after switching tabs, sorting and buying), whether the F7 box shows line breaks and closes cleanly, and whether sprinting works in and out of combat. Logs: the newest `ME1Client_*.txt` in Archipelago's `logs` folder.

An existing 0.2.x career keeps working. Shops you already visited have no slots.
